account: Parth Khairnar and Geetha S at the Vellore Institute of Technology, Chennai, propose a model that adjusts credit-scoring thresholds for subprime lending. The team says that it used the public Home Credit Default Risk dataset. The team reports that initial testing used synthetic simulations in Google Colab. The team says that a rural implementation and a peer-reviewed paper were still to come. Borrowing and lending benefits in practice are unreported.
